target: close to dense on this balanced finite test set
rationale: Conservative finite-sample engineering acceptance target, not a population non-inferiority guarantee.
Overall 2 percentage points, each task 5 points, each task/budget 10 points; at most 5% of dense-perfect examples may regress.
Draft recorded before pilot completion; freeze after author calibration and before any holdout model outputs.
If the seed fails the intended pilot target, revise the implementation on pilot data; never loosen the holdout margin after observing it.
official_metric: case-insensitive reference substring recall, extra incorrect answers unpenalized; official generation budgets fixed
